Ziffr to Google Tasks

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, the email address you have in Ziffr (assigneeEmail) and the id of the task list (`@default` is your main list).
2. Add the Google Tasks credential to the three HTTP Request nodes.
3. Replace the Webhook path with a long random string, activate the workflow and put its production URL into the Webhook in Ziffr (events: action.created, action.updated, action.done).

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/google-tasks.md
